summary: Sandbach United fought back from behind in an entertaining encounter, with substitutes making a real impact as they mounted a comeback that saw them level at 2-2 through top scorer O'Connell before Foley put them ahead at 77 minutes. However, the Ramblers were denied all three points in heartbreaking fashion when Nomads equalised with seconds remaining to finish 3-3. It was a frustrating end to a match where the changes from the bench transformed the team's midfield control and attacking threat in the second half.
